kind.description: AUDIT_SETTINGS: the audit's daily run time, time zone or on/off. ADD_STATEMENT: a new statement. ADD_CHECK: a new check on a saved run, linked to a statement.

time.description: AUDIT_SETTINGS: the daily run time as HH:mm.

timeZone.description: AUDIT_SETTINGS: an IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.

active.description: AUDIT_SETTINGS: true to run the audit, false to stop it.

weight.description: ADD_STATEMENT: the statement's weight code; leave out for the default.

savedRunId.description: ADD_CHECK: the saved run the check reads.

statementCode.description: ADD_CHECK: the audit's statement the check serves.

diffTypes.description: ADD_CHECK: the diff types the check keeps; leave out for all.

reasonText.description: Why, citing the person's words; at most 1000 characters.
